name: Freedom Park
subtitle: A heritage precinct of memorial sites on Salvokop Hill, Pretoria, commemorating those who died in conflicts that shaped South Africa.

facts.label: Reeds
facts.value: Semicircle of 200 reeds signifying rebirth as a nation

parts.text: A heritage precinct of memorial sites on Salvokop Hill, Pretoria, commemorating those who died in conflicts that shaped South Africa. It includes S'khumbuto, a wall of names and a gallery of leaders.
